title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
summary: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”

title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
summary: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.

title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
summary: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

title: XRP Ledger’s Payment Engine Had a Counterfeiting Bug Hiding Since 2015
summary: An integer overflow in the payment engine, dormant since 2015, could have let an attacker mint spendable XRP beyond the token’s total supply.

title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
summary: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.

title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
summary: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.
